admission.justification: Spans the language-agnostic tags.scm engine and LanguageSet provider/reservation seam, and is guarded by tags-engine policy, .lean reservation, and Lean anchor tests.

applicability: All tree-sitter citation languages executed by tags_engine and all LanguageSet suffix registrations.
conditions: Tree-sitter bindings execute standard upstream @definition.* and @name tags.scm captures while tolerating @doc and @local.* captures.
Engine-side wrapper widening preserves declaration lines, DestructuringSpec unpacks bound-side leaves only, has_error nodes are skipped, and output preserves document order.
Lean declarations execute via LeanLanguageProvider behind LanguageProvider, and LanguageSet permanently refuses binding .lean to any tree-sitter or non-Lean provider.
exclusions: Lean does not use tree-sitter or tags.scm queries.
statement: Every tree-sitter language executes declaratively through the language-agnostic tags.scm engine using standard upstream captures with engine-side wrapper widening, bound-side destructuring, error skipping, and document ordering, while Lean stays behind LanguageProvider with .lean permanently reserved.
title: Declarative tags.scm engine extracts bindings while .lean stays reserved
